in_sanskrit.name: Azzu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Resplendent, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Azzu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Azzu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'azz', which means 'shining' or 'resplendent'. It is a name that signifies radiance and brilliance. In Hindu mythology, Azzu is associated with the sun god Surya and represents the power of light and illumination.
